movies.blurb: George Reeves' first outing as Superman — the first-ever feature film based on a DC character, and the pilot for Adventures of Superman.
Christopher Reeve's origin-to-icon debut; the film that proved a superhero movie could be prestige cinema.
Zod and the Phantom Zone criminals arrive; Superman gives up his powers for Lois, then takes them back.
A tonal swing toward comedy, pitting Superman against a corrupted version of himself and Richard Pryor's hacker.
Kara's solo spin-off from the Superman film series, poorly received on release.

movies.t: Superman IV: The Quest for Peace
movies.blurb: A famously troubled production sees Superman take on nuclear disarmament and Nuclear Man.
Bryan Singer's spiritual sequel to Superman II, ignoring III and IV, with Brandon Routh as Clark.
Wes Craven's B-movie take on the muck-monster hero, based on the Len Wein/Bernie Wrightson comic.
A campier sequel leaning further into B-movie horror-comedy.
Tim Burton's gothic, operatic take on Gotham, with Jack Nicholson's Joker.
Burton doubles down on the grotesque with Catwoman and Penguin as tragic monsters.
Joel Schumacher brightens the tone considerably; Two-Face and the Riddler headline.
Neon camp excess that effectively ended the franchise until Nolan's reboot.
Shaquille O'Neal stars as John Henry Irons, loosely based on the post-Death of Superman hero.
Halle Berry stars in a version of Catwoman not directly tied to the comics character.
Keanu Reeves as a chain-smoking occult detective, loosely based on Hellblazer.
Christopher Nolan grounds Batman's origin in realism; the start of The Dark Knight Trilogy.

movies.cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart, Michael Caine, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Gary Oldman
movies.plot: With Gotham's underworld in disarray, the Joker emerges as a force of pure chaos, pushing Batman, Jim Gordon, and DA Harvey Dent to their moral limits as they try to save a city that may not deserve saving.
movies.blurb: Heath Ledger's Joker anchors a crime-thriller take on Batman vs. chaos.
Bane and Talia al Ghul close out the trilogy with Gotham under siege.
Zack Snyder's dense adaptation of Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons' deconstruction of superheroes.
Alan Moore and David Lloyd's dystopian anarchist tale, adapted by the Wachowskis (as writers/producers).
A fantasy romance based on Neil Gaiman and Charles Vess' Vertigo miniseries.
A black-ops team framed for a crime they didn't commit, based on the Vertigo series.
A poorly-received Western adaptation of DC's scarred bounty-hunter antihero.
Retired black-ops agents are targeted for elimination, based on Warren Ellis and Cully Hamner's WildStorm miniseries.
The sequel to Red, sending the retired team on a globe-trotting mission.
Three mob wives take over their husbands' Hell's Kitchen rackets, based on the DC Vertigo miniseries.
A Depression-era mob drama based on Max Allan Collins' graphic novel, published under DC's Paradox Press imprint.
A diner owner's violent past resurfaces, based on the graphic novel published by DC/Vertigo.
Victorian literary icons team up, based on Alan Moore and Kevin O'Neill's WildStorm series.

movies.cast: Ryan Reynolds, Blake Lively, Peter Sarsgaard, Mark Strong
movies.plot: Test pilot Hal Jordan becomes the first human Green Lantern, gaining a power ring from a dying alien and joining an intergalactic police force to defend Earth from the fear-fueled entity Parallax.
movies.blurb: Ryan Reynolds' first superhero outing, a critical and commercial disappointment for the character's live-action debut.

movies.cast: Henry Cavill, Amy Adams, Michael Shannon, Russell Crowe, Kevin Costner, Diane Lane
movies.plot: Clark Kent, unsure of whether the world is ready for a superpowered alien among them, must decide whether to reveal himself as Superman when General Zod and the Kryptonian remnant threaten Earth in search of the Codex Clark's father hid before Krypton's destruction.
movies.blurb: Zack Snyder relaunches Superman as a darker, mythic figure; opens the DC Extended Universe.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Amy Adams, Jesse Eisenberg, Gal Gadot, Diane Lane
movies.plot: Fearing Superman's power is unchecked and dangerous, Batman goes to war against him while the world debates the hero's place in it — until Lex Luthor manipulates both into becoming pawns of a greater threat.
movies.t: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
movies.blurb: Introduces Ben Affleck's Batman and sets up the Justice League; also the first live-action Wonder Woman.

movies.cast: Will Smith, Jared Leto, Margot Robbie, Joel Kinnaman, Viola Davis
movies.plot: A secret government agency recruits imprisoned supervillains for dangerous black-ops missions in exchange for reduced sentences, deploying them against a mystical threat that emerges in Midway City.
movies.blurb: A team of imprisoned villains is sent on a black-ops mission.

movies.cast: Gal Gadot, Chris Pine, Robin Wright, Danny Huston, David Thewlis, Connie Nielsen
movies.plot: Diana, an Amazon princess raised on the hidden island of Themyscira, leaves her home to fight in World War I after rescuing an American pilot, discovering the full extent of her powers and heritage along the way.
movies.blurb: Diana's WWI-set origin, widely seen as a turning point for the DCEU's critical reception.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Gal Gadot, Ezra Miller, Jason Momoa, Ray Fisher
movies.plot: Following Superman's death, Batman and Wonder Woman recruit Flash, Aquaman, and Cyborg to stand against the newly awakened threat of Steppenwolf and his army of Parademons.
movies.blurb: The theatrical cut, finished by Joss Whedon after Snyder departed production.

movies.cast: Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Gal Gadot, Ezra Miller, Jason Momoa, Ray Fisher
movies.plot: Zack Snyder's original vision for the team-up, restoring cut material and reshaping the story into a four-part, four-hour cut released directly to streaming rather than theaters.
movies.boxOffice: HBO Max exclusive release — no theatrical run
movies.blurb: The four-hour director's cut released after years of fan campaigning; a substantially different film from 2017's.

movies.cast: Jason Momoa, Amber Heard, Willem Dafoe, Patrick Wilson, Nicole Kidman
movies.plot: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry must reluctantly embrace his birthright and unite the underwater kingdoms to stop his power-hungry half-brother Orm from waging war on the surface world.
movies.blurb: Arthur Curry claims the throne of Atlantis in a colorful, undersea epic.

movies.cast: Zachary Levi, Asher Angel, Mark Strong, Jack Dylan Grazer
movies.plot: Foster kid Billy Batson can transform into the adult superhero Shazam by saying a wizard's name, and must learn to use his powers responsibly while facing the monstrous Seven Deadly Sins.
movies.blurb: A foster kid who transforms into an adult hero, played with family-comedy warmth.

movies.cast: Margot Robbie, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Jurnee Smollett, Ewan McGregor
movies.plot: After splitting from the Joker, Harley Quinn joins forces with Black Canary, Huntress, and Renee Montoya to protect a young pickpocket from the sadistic crime lord Roman Sionis.
movies.blurb: Harley Quinn, freshly split from the Joker, teams up with Gotham's other women.

movies.cast: Gal Gadot, Chris Pine, Kristen Wiig, Pedro Pascal
movies.plot: Decades after WWI, Diana Prince must contend with a wish-granting ancient artifact that resurrects Steve Trevor and empowers a new, dangerously ambitious foe: the Cheetah.
movies.blurb: Diana faces a wish-granting artifact in the excess of the Reagan era.

movies.cast: Margot Robbie, Idris Elba, John Cena, Joel Kinnaman, Sylvester Stallone (voice), Viola Davis
movies.plot: A new, mostly-expendable lineup of imprisoned supervillains is sent to the island nation of Corto Maltese to destroy a secret Nazi-era research facility before a project called Starro is unleashed.
movies.blurb: James Gunn's R-rated, mostly standalone reboot of the concept.

movies.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Aldis Hodge, Noah Centineo, Sarah Shahi, Pierce Brosnan
movies.plot: Nearly 5,000 years after being bestowed with the almighty powers of the Egyptian gods, Teth-Adam is freed from his earthly tomb, ready to unleash his unique form of justice on the modern world.
movies.blurb: Dwayne Johnson's antihero is freed from millennia of imprisonment.

movies.cast: Zachary Levi, Asher Angel, Helen Mirren, Lucy Liu
movies.plot: The now-teenage Shazamily faces the vengeful Daughters of Atlas, who seek to reclaim the magic stolen from the gods and threaten to unravel the world.
movies.blurb: The Shazam family faces the daughters of Atlas.

movies.cast: Ezra Miller, Michael Keaton, Sasha Calle, Michael Shannon
movies.plot: Barry Allen uses his speed to travel back in time to prevent his mother's murder, inadvertently fracturing the timeline and colliding with alternate versions of Batman and a doomed Krypton.
movies.blurb: Barry Allen's time-travel misadventure, and the effective finale of the Snyderverse continuity.

movies.cast: Xolo Maridueña, Bruna Marquezine, George Lopez, Susan Sarandon
movies.plot: Recent college grad Jaime Reyes becomes bonded to an ancient alien scarab that grants him a powerful suit of armor, forcing him to protect his family from a ruthless tech CEO.
movies.blurb: Jaime Reyes bonds with an alien scarab; the last new DCEU hero introduced.

movies.cast: Jason Momoa, Patrick Wilson, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Amber Heard
movies.plot: Arthur Curry must team with his imprisoned brother Orm to stop Black Manta, who wields the power of the mythic Black Trident and threatens to unleash an ancient, world-ending force.
movies.blurb: The final film released under the original DCEU banner.

movies.cast: Joaquin Phoenix, Robert De Niro, Zazie Beetz, Frances Conroy
movies.plot: Failed comedian Arthur Fleck, ground down by a city that has abandoned its most vulnerable, undergoes a breakdown that leads him to embrace violence and become an icon of chaos in a decaying Gotham.
movies.blurb: A grounded character study of Arthur Fleck's descent, disconnected from any shared DC continuity.

movies.cast: Joaquin Phoenix, Lady Gaga, Brendan Gleeson, Catherine Keener
movies.plot: Awaiting trial in Arkham State Hospital, Arthur Fleck falls for fellow patient Lee Quinzel as the two channel their shared bond into an increasingly public, musical descent.
movies.blurb: A musical-tinged sequel following Arthur's trial and his bond with Harley Quinn.

movies.cast: Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz, Paul Dano, Jeffrey Wright, Colin Farrell, John Turturro
movies.plot: In his second year fighting crime, a reclusive, obsessive Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham's political and criminal elite while hunting the Riddler, a serial killer targeting the city's most powerful figures.
movies.blurb: Matt Reeves' noir detective-thriller take, standalone from the DCEU and DCU.

movies.cast: David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan, Nicholas Hoult, Edi Gathegi, Anthony Carrigan
movies.plot: James Gunn's relaunch follows an earlier-in-career Superman balancing his Kryptonian heritage and human upbringing while Lex Luthor manipulates public opinion against him, opening the new shared DC Universe.
movies.blurb: James Gunn's relaunch of the character, opening the new shared DC Universe (DCU).

movies.cast: Milly Alcock, Matthias Schoenaerts, Eve Ridley, David Krumholtz, Emily Beecham, Jason Momoa
movies.plot: Kara Zor-El, still finding her footing as a hero on Earth, reluctantly teams with a scarred outsider for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice after a brutal attack strikes close to home.
movies.blurb: Milly Alcock's Kara Zor-El, the second live-action film of the new DCU.
A body-horror take on the shapeshifting Batman villain, set in the new DCU.
The Superman sequel, continuing the DCU's Chapter 1 slate.
Matt Reeves' sequel to The Batman, currently filming.

movies.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Kate McKinnon, John Krasinski, Marc Maron, Keanu Reeves
movies.plot: Superman's loyal dog Krypto teams with a ragtag group of shelter pets who gain powers of their own, banding together to rescue the Justice League after they're captured by Lex Luthor and a vengeful guinea pig.
movies.blurb: Krypto and a shelter-pet squad get powers of their own in this CG animated comedy.
An Aztec-set reimagining of Batman, released theatrically in Mexico.
A feature film extension of Batman: The Animated Series, considered one of the best Batman films in any medium.

movies.cast: Will Arnett, Michael Cera, Rosario Dawson, Zach Galifianakis, Ralph Fiennes
movies.plot: A comedic spin-off of The Lego Movie in which an emotionally stunted, glory-obsessed Batman must learn to work with others — including an accidentally-adopted Robin — after the Joker orchestrates his most personal scheme yet.
movies.blurb: A comedic spin-off of The Lego Movie, sending up decades of Batman media.

movies.cast: Greg Cipes, Scott Menville, Khary Payton, Tara Strong, Hynden Walch, Will Arnett
movies.plot: Jealous that every other hero has their own movie, the chibi Teen Titans set out to get one of their own, running afoul of a supervillain plot and a wickedly meta send-up of the superhero movie genre along the way.
movies.t: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
movies.blurb: The chibi Teen Titans satirize the superhero movie genre itself.
Batman and Robin race to save Barbara Gordon after Mr. Freeze kidnaps her for a transfusion.

movies.t: Batman Beyond: Return of the Joker
movies.blurb: An older Bruce Wayne and successor Terry McGinnis confront a resurrected Joker.
A mysterious new Batwoman appears in Gotham, and Batman must uncover her identity.
Set in The Batman TV series' universe, Dracula rises in Gotham after the Penguin unearths his coffin.
Loosely connected to Superman: The Animated Series but not considered official DCAU continuity.
Adapts the Death of Superman storyline; opens the long-running DC Universe Animated Original Movies line.
Based on Darwyn Cooke's DC: The New Frontier, set against the backdrop of the Cold War.
Six anime-style shorts bridging Batman Begins and The Dark Knight.
An origin story pitting Diana against Ares, loosely based on 'Gods and Mortals'.
A standalone adaptation of Hal Jordan's induction into the Green Lantern Corps.
With the U.S. President framing Superman for murder, Batman and Superman team up on the run.

movies.t: Justice League: Crisis on Two Earths
movies.blurb: A parallel-Earth Justice League of evildoers threatens to invade the heroes' world.
A resurrected Jason Todd returns as a lethal vigilante challenging Batman's no-kill rule.
Supergirl's arrival on Earth draws the attention of Darkseid and Apokolips.
A faithful adaptation of the acclaimed Morrison/Quitely comic, sending a dying Superman through twelve labors.
An anthology of Green Lantern Corps tales framed by Hal Jordan's training.
A faithful adaptation of Frank Miller and David Mazzucchelli's foundational origin story.

movies.cast: Justin Chambers, Kevin Conroy, C. Thomas Howell, Michael B. Jordan, Cary Elwes, Nathan Fillion, Vanessa Marshall, Dana Delany
movies.plot: The Flash wakes in a fractured alternate timeline where his mother lives, his powers are gone, and a war between the Amazons and Atlanteans is destroying the world — forcing him to find a grittier, unfamiliar Batman to help restore reality.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 1 — Barry Allen wakes in an altered timeline after trying to prevent his mother's death.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Sean Astin, Shemar Moore, Christopher Gorham, Alan Tudyk, Justin Kirk, Michelle Monaghan
movies.plot: A New 52-inspired retelling of the Justice League's first battle, as Batman, Green Lantern, Superman, Wonder Woman, Flash, and Cyborg unite for the first time to stop an invasion by Darkseid's forces.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 2 — a New 52-inspired retelling of the League's first battle against Darkseid.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Stuart Allan, Thomas Gibson, Sean Maher, Morena Baccarin
movies.plot: Batman discovers he has a son, Damian Wayne, secretly raised as a killer by the League of Assassins — and must train the violent, unruly boy while facing Damian's grandfather, Ra's al Ghul, and the mercenary Deathstroke.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 3 — Batman discovers and trains his son, Damian Wayne.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, C.C.H. Pounder, Neal McDonough, Hynden Walch, Troy Baker
movies.plot: Set in the Batman: Arkham video game continuity, the Suicide Squad is sent to infiltrate Arkham Asylum and steal sensitive data from the Riddler — only to stumble into a bomb plot that draws Batman himself into the mix.
movies.blurb: Set in the Batman: Arkham video game universe, the Suicide Squad infiltrates Arkham Asylum.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Matt Lanter, Shemar Moore, Rosario Dawson, Jerry O'Connell, Sam Witwer
movies.plot: Arthur Curry is revealed to be the lost heir to the throne of Atlantis, and must decide whether to claim it as war breaks out between Atlantis and the surface world under his half-brother Orm's warmongering rule.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 4 — introduces Aquaman and the war between Atlantis and the surface.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Stuart Allan, Troy Baker, Kevin Conroy, Sean Maher
movies.plot: Struggling to accept Batman's no-kill rule, a young Damian Wayne is lured toward the secretive Court of Owls, forcing Batman and the ghost of Talia al Ghul's influence into a confrontation over Damian's future.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 5 — Damian Wayne is lured toward the secret society Court of Owls.
An alternate-universe Justice League with darker, morally ambiguous origins.

movies.cast: Jason O'Mara, Yvonne Strahovski, Stuart Allan, Sean Maher, Morena Baccarin
movies.plot: With Bruce Wayne missing, Alfred covers for his absence while Nightwing and Robin patrol Gotham, and a mysterious new Batwoman investigates alongside them to uncover what happened to Batman.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 6 — with Batman missing, Batwoman and Nightwing lead a new Bat-family.
DCAMU film 7 — Damian Wayne joins the Teen Titans while Trigon threatens Earth.

movies.cast: Kevin Conroy, Mark Hamill, Tara Strong, Ray Wise
movies.plot: An adaptation of Alan Moore and Brian Bolland's one-shot, exploring the thin line between sanity and madness as the Joker attempts to prove that one bad day can break anyone — including Commissioner Gordon and Batman himself.
movies.blurb: An adaptation of Moore/Bolland's Joker-origin one-shot, with an added first act.

movies.t: Batman: Return of the Caped Crusaders
movies.blurb: Adam West and Burt Ward reprise their 1960s roles in this animated homage.

movies.cast: Matt Ryan, Camilla Luddington, Jason O'Mara, Ray Chase, Jerry O'Connell, Rosario Dawson
movies.plot: When the Justice League proves powerless against a wave of supernatural madness sweeping the world, Batman turns to Constantine, Zatanna, Etrigan, and other magic-wielding outcasts to investigate and confront the source.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 8 — Constantine assembles DC's magical misfits against a supernatural threat.

movies.plot: As Nightwing recruits new members for a struggling Teen Titans, the team's newest addition — Terra — hides a secret allegiance to the assassin Deathstroke, threatening to tear the team apart from within.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 9 — a new Titan may be a spy for the assassin Deathstroke.
Batman and Nightwing reluctantly team with Harley Quinn to stop Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue.
Adam West's final performance as Batman, against William Shatner's Two-Face.

movies.t: Scooby-Doo! & Batman: The Brave and the Bold
movies.blurb: A crossover between the Scooby gang and the Brave and the Bold animated series.

movies.cast: Bruce Greenwood, Jennifer Carpenter
movies.plot: An adaptation of DC's first-ever Elseworlds story, transplanting Batman into Victorian-era Gotham to hunt a killer bearing an unsettling resemblance to Jack the Ripper.
movies.blurb: A Victorian-era Batman hunts a killer resembling Jack the Ripper — the first Elseworlds story ever adapted.

movies.plot: Amanda Waller sends the Suicide Squad racing against the vigilante Blackhawks to recover a set of powerful magical relics before they fall into the wrong hands.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 10 — the Squad races the Blackhawks for powerful magic relics.

movies.cast: Roger Craig Smith, Tony Hale, Grey Griffin, Fred Tatasciore
movies.plot: A quirk-of-science mishap hurls Batman, Alfred, and a host of his rogues gallery into feudal Japan, where the villains have carved out warring fiefdoms and Batman must rally unlikely allies to set history back on course.
movies.blurb: An anime reimagining that hurls Batman and his rogues into feudal Japan.

movies.cast: Jerry O'Connell, Rebecca Romijn, Rainn Wilson, Jason O'Mara, Rosario Dawson, Nathan Fillion
movies.plot: A newer, more brutal animated take on the classic storyline: an unstoppable creature called Doomsday rampages toward Metropolis, and only Superman stands a chance of stopping it — at a cost.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 11 — a newer, more brutal adaptation of the Doomsday storyline.

movies.cast: Jerry O'Connell, Rebecca Romijn, Rainn Wilson, Cameron Monaghan, Cress Williams, Patrick Fabian, Shemar Moore
movies.plot: In the wake of Superman's death, four mysterious figures each claim to be his successor, and the Justice League must determine which — if any — is the real Man of Steel returned.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 12 — the direct follow-up, tracking the four pretenders to Superman's mantle.

movies.t: Justice League vs. the Fatal Five
movies.blurb: Loosely tied to Justice League Unlimited, pitting the League against future villains.

movies.t: Batman vs. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
movies.blurb: A crossover team-up produced with Nickelodeon, based on the IDW comic.
DCAMU film 13 — adapts Loeb/Lee's mystery pitting Batman against nearly his entire rogues gallery.

movies.t: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
movies.blurb: A crossover between the comedic Teen Titans Go! and the original, more serious Teen Titans series.

movies.cast: Rosario Dawson
movies.plot: Diana's origin on Themyscira is retold alongside a modern-day threat as her childhood friend Barbara Minerva transforms into the villainous Cheetah, forcing Diana to confront a foe from her own past.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 14 — Diana's origin retold alongside a modern-day threat from Cheetah and Silver Swan.

movies.plot: An animated adaptation of the Elseworlds classic imagining Superman's rocket landing in Soviet Ukraine instead of Kansas, growing up to become the Soviet Union's ultimate weapon rather than America's greatest hero.
movies.blurb: Adapts the Elseworlds comic where Superman's rocket lands in Soviet Ukraine instead of Kansas.

movies.cast: Matt Ryan, Jerry O'Connell, Rosario Dawson, Jason O'Mara
movies.plot: With Darkseid's forces having overrun Earth, the surviving heroes mount one final, desperate offensive against Apokolips itself — a brutal, continuity-closing finale to the DC Animated Movie Universe.
movies.blurb: DCAMU film 15 — a brutal, continuity-closing finale to the interconnected animated movie line.
A younger, still-adjusting Clark Kent meets Lobo and Parasite in a rebooted animated continuity.
A martial-arts-flavored '70s throwback pitting young Bruce Wayne's old kung-fu classmates against a demonic threat.
The Flash is thrown back to WWII to fight alongside the Justice Society.

movies.cast: Jensen Ackles, Josh Duhamel, Naya Rivera, Troy Baker
movies.plot: Early in his career, Batman teams with Jim Gordon and Harvey Dent to hunt a mysterious killer called Holiday, who strikes once on every major holiday, while the mob families of Gotham fracture under the pressure.
movies.t: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part One
movies.blurb: Part one of an adaptation of Loeb/Sale's year-spanning murder mystery.

movies.cast: Jensen Ackles, Josh Duhamel, Naya Rivera, Troy Baker
movies.plot: As the Holiday killings continue and Harvey Dent's transformation into Two-Face unfolds, Batman closes in on a killer whose identity will permanently reshape Gotham's criminal landscape.
movies.t: Batman: The Long Halloween, Part Two
movies.blurb: The concluding half, revealing the killer behind Gotham's holiday murders.

movies.cast: Justin Hartley, Anson Mount
movies.plot: An adaptation of the alternate-universe video game and comic in which the Joker tricks Superman into killing a pregnant Lois Lane, sending him down a path toward authoritarian rule that splits the Justice League in two.
movies.blurb: Adapts the alternate-universe video game/comic in which Superman becomes a tyrant.
Selina Kyle chases a MacGuffin across Europe in an anime-inflected heist thriller.

movies.t: Teen Titans Go! & DC Super Hero Girls: Mayhem in the Multiverse
movies.blurb: A multiverse-hopping crossover between the two comedic animated lines.
John Stewart becomes Earth's Green Lantern in this rebooted animated continuity.

movies.plot: Damian Wayne and Jon Kent are pulled across dimensions to a parallel Earth where a corrupted, Gog-driven Superman rules with an iron fist, forcing the two Super Sons to team up and set things right.
movies.t: Batman and Superman: Battle of the Super Sons
movies.blurb: Damian Wayne and Jon Kent team up across dimensions against the Gog-driven Superman of Earth-2.

movies.plot: Kara Zor-El travels to the 31st century, where she joins a team of teenage heroes drawing on powers from across the galaxy to defend the United Planets from an emerging threat.
movies.blurb: Supergirl joins a 31st-century team of teenage heroes in this continuation of the rebooted animated universe.

movies.t: Batman: The Doom That Came to Gotham
movies.blurb: A Lovecraftian Elseworlds tale pitting Batman against cosmic horrors in 1920s Gotham.

movies.plot: The concluding chapter of the rebooted animated continuity's Superman arc, sending the Man of Steel and a band of allies to the gladiatorial planet Warworld to rescue enslaved friends and confront its tyrant ruler.
movies.blurb: The concluding chapter of the rebooted animated continuity's Superman/Legion arc.

movies.cast: Luke Wilson, Yonas Kibreab, David Hornsby, James Cromwell
movies.plot: A young Damian Wayne, thrilled to finally be old enough to help his crime-fighting father, is left home alone on Christmas Eve — and takes it upon himself to save Christmas after every villain in Gotham's rogues gallery escapes at once.
movies.blurb: A young Damian Wayne tries to save Christmas himself while Batman is away.

movies.plot: The opening chapter of the DCAMU's adaptation of the original Crisis event, as heroes across the multiverse begin to realize a wave of destruction is erasing entire parallel Earths.
movies.t: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths – Part One
movies.blurb: DCAMU films 23–25 — adapts the original multiverse-erasing Crisis event, closing out the DCAMU continuity.

movies.plot: As the Anti-Monitor's assault intensifies, the assembled heroes make increasingly desperate sacrifices in a losing battle to save what remains of the multiverse.
movies.t: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths – Part Two
movies.blurb: The middle chapter of the DCAMU's Crisis finale.

movies.plot: The concluding chapter, in which the surviving heroes make a final stand against the Anti-Monitor to save a merged, singular Earth — bringing the 15-year DC Animated Movie Universe to a close.
movies.t: Justice League: Crisis on Infinite Earths – Part Three
movies.blurb: The concluding chapter, closing out the 15-year DC Animated Movie Universe continuity.
A faithful animated adaptation of the first half of Watchmen, produced with Paramount.
The concluding half of the animated Watchmen adaptation.
A sequel to Batman Ninja, pulling the wider Justice League into feudal Japan.
The first of a planned trilogy adapting the comics arc where Bane breaks Batman's back.
The second chapter of the Knightfall animated trilogy — announced/upcoming.
The concluding chapter of the Knightfall animated trilogy — announced/upcoming.

movies.t: DC Super Hero Girls: Super Hero High
movies.blurb: The pilot feature for the DC Super Hero Girls animated shorts universe.

movies.t: DC Super Hero Girls: Hero of the Year
movies.blurb: The Super Hero High students compete for the title of Hero of the Year.

movies.t: DC Super Hero Girls: Intergalactic Games
movies.blurb: An intergalactic athletic competition tests the Super Hero High students.

movies.t: DC Super Hero Girls: Legends of Atlantis
movies.blurb: The Super Hero Girls dive into an undersea adventure in Atlantis.

movies.t: Lego Batman: The Movie – DC Super Heroes Unite
movies.blurb: Based on the Lego Batman 2 video game, Batman teams with Superman against Lex Luthor and the Joker.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League vs. Bizarro League
movies.blurb: Lex Luthor creates evil duplicates of the Justice League using Bizarro's cloning powers.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League – Attack of the Legion of Doom
movies.blurb: The Legion of Doom assembles to take down the Lego Justice League.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League – Cosmic Clash
movies.blurb: Brainiac shrinks and bottles cities across the galaxy, including parts of Metropolis.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League – Gotham City Breakout
movies.blurb: Arkham Asylum's inmates escape, forcing Batman to call in the League.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: The Flash
movies.blurb: A Lego adventure spotlighting Barry Allen's speedster heroics.

movies.t: Lego DC Comics Super Heroes: Aquaman – Rage of Atlantis
movies.blurb: A Lego adventure sending Aquaman to defend Atlantis.
A mysterious figure claiming to be Batman's father-in-law arrives in Gotham.

movies.t: Lego DC Shazam!: Magic and Monsters
movies.blurb: A Lego take on Shazam facing off against a resurrected wizard threat.
Toyline-based feature where Batman's rogues turn feral thanks to Man-Bat's serum.
Killer Croc leads a monster-themed rogues gallery against the Bat-family.
The Bat-family suits up in mechs against a mutated rogues gallery.

movies.t: Superman: The Last Son of Krypton
movies.blurb: A compilation of Superman: The Animated Series' opening episodes, retelling his origin.
A compilation film from the Superman: TAS crossover episodes that first paired the two heroes in the DCAU.
A compilation of Batman Beyond's first two episodes, introducing Terry McGinnis.
A compilation of the Justice League animated series' opening episodes.
A compilation of the Justice League series finale, in which the Thanagarians invade Earth.

movies.t: Constantine: City of Demons – The Movie
